activity-log.desc_en: Who changed what and when: products, prices, orders, coupons, pages, users, plugins and settings, with the source of every change (admin, REST, WP-CLI, Site Bridge). No secrets and no customer details, masked IPs, e-mail for critical changes.

back-in-stock.desc_el: Φόρμα «Ειδοποίησέ με όταν ξαναέρθει» σε εξαντλημένα προϊόντα και παραλλαγές: επιβεβαίωση με email για τους επισκέπτες, ένα email όταν το προϊόν ξαναμπεί σε απόθεμα, αποστολή σε παρτίδες στο παρασκήνιο και ζήτηση ανά προϊόν, χωρίς newsletter.
back-in-stock.desc_en: A «Notify me when it is back» form on out-of-stock products and variations: email confirmation for guests, one email when the product is back in stock, background sending in batches and demand per product, no newsletter.
back-in-stock.name: Back in Stock

beta.changelog: * Support links (the footer pill and the Donate link) point to noxpress.tech/support/ instead of Ko-fi, with the label «♡ Support Noxpress». Noxpress Core 1.6.0: the same link in the hub, and Visitor Language in the suite catalogue.

book-feed.desc_el: Τίτλοι άλλων εκδοτικών από τον κατάλογο Bookpoint (ΟΣΔΕΛ) ως προϊόντα: αναζήτηση και εισαγωγή, κανόνες ανά εκδότη και καθημερινός συγχρονισμός τιμής και διαθεσιμότητας.
book-feed.desc_en: Titles of other publishers from the Bookpoint catalogue (OSDEL) as products: search and import, rules per publisher and a daily sync of price and availability.
book-feed.name: Book Feed

beta.changelog: * Support links (the footer pill and the Donate link) point to noxpress.tech/support/ instead of Ko-fi, with the label «♡ Support Noxpress». Noxpress Core 1.6.0: the same link in the hub, and Visitor Language in the suite catalogue.

book-preview.desc_el: Δείγμα βιβλίου στη σελίδα του προϊόντος: ξεχωριστό PDF μόνο με τις σελίδες που διαλέγεις.
book-preview.desc_en: A book sample on the product page: a separate PDF with only the pages you choose.
book-preview.name: Book Preview

beta.changelog: * Support links (the footer pill and the Donate link) point to noxpress.tech/support/ instead of Ko-fi, with the label «♡ Support Noxpress». Noxpress Core 1.6.0: the same link in the hub, and Visitor Language in the suite catalogue.

broadcast.desc_el: Ανακοινώνει γεγονότα του site σε ένα Viber Channel: νέα προϊόντα, newsletter που στάλθηκε, νέα βίντεο YouTube και αναρτήσεις που ετοιμάζεις, με ουρά, έγκριση και ιστορικό.
broadcast.desc_en: Announces your site's events on a Viber Channel: new products, a newsletter that went out, new YouTube videos, new Instagram posts and posts you prepare. A queue with approval, one template per source, no duplicates, a full history.
broadcast.name: Broadcast

beta.changelog:
* Privacy (Bible §12 «Προσωπικά δεδομένα»): Tools → Export / Erase Personal Data now cover Checkout Extras. The export lists the address's gift messages and thank-you coupon codes per order, its thank-you coupons (code, expiry, used) and, when Cart Abandonment Recovery for WooCommerce is there, its tracked carts (time, status, total). The eraser deletes the gift messages of orders that are no longer open (an open order keeps it for packing, with a message), the address's thank-you coupons (the statistics read order meta and stay) and its tracked carts with their e-mail history rows. When WooCommerce anonymises an order, the gift message goes with it.
* Suggested privacy policy text (Settings → Privacy) for the gift message, the thank-you coupon and abandoned carts.

checkout-extras.desc_el: Δώρο με αφιέρωση στο ταμείο, μήνυμα και προϊόντα στη σελίδα ευχαριστίας, και κουπόνι ευχαριστίας για την επόμενη παραγγελία.
checkout-extras.desc_en: A gift option with a message at checkout, a message and products on the thank-you page, and a thank-you coupon for the next order.
checkout-extras.name: Checkout Extras

beta.changelog: * Support links (the footer pill and the Donate link) point to noxpress.tech/support/ instead of Ko-fi, with the label «♡ Support Noxpress». Noxpress Core 1.6.0: the same link in the hub, and Visitor Language in the suite catalogue.

data-migrator.desc_el: Πλήρες αντίγραφο ασφαλείας και επαναφορά του site, εδώ ή σε άλλον server, με αλλαγή domain χωρίς χειροκίνητες διορθώσεις.
data-migrator.desc_en: Full backup and restore of the site, here or on another server, with a domain change and no manual fixes.
data-migrator.name: Data Migrator

beta.changelog: * Lowest price of 30 days, art. 9ι of Greek law 2251/1994: progressive reductions within 60 days now show the price before the first reduction, and a product on the market for less than 30 days its lowest price since launch. New installs show the line under WooCommerce's own sale prices too; existing settings stay as they are.

discount-rules.desc_el: Κανόνες εκπτώσεων με ημερομηνίες: προσφορές σε προϊόντα και κατηγορίες, κλιμακωτή έκπτωση ποσότητας, «3 για 2» και έκπτωση καλαθιού, με ανώτατο όριο ανά παραγγελία, δοκιμή καλαθιού και τη χαμηλότερη τιμή 30 ημερών (Omnibus).
discount-rules.desc_en: Dated discount rules: sales on products and categories, quantity tiers, «3 for 2» and a cart discount, with an order cap, a test cart and the lowest price of 30 days (Omnibus).
discount-rules.name: Discount Rules

beta.changelog:
* Art. 3ζα of law 2251/1994 (Greek transposition of the EU withdrawal button, law 5317/2026): the default Greek label is now «Πατήστε εδώ για υπαναχώρηση», the wording of the law. A label you never changed («Υπαναχώρηση από τη σύμβαση εδώ») switches by itself; a label you wrote stays.
* The automatic link at the end of every page is on by default, so the function stays easy to find for the whole withdrawal period. Shops that saved it off keep it off.
* New warning in the admin (dashboard, plugins screen, plugin pages) when the shop is live, the automatic link is off and no menu links to the form page; it can be hidden by a user who added a link elsewhere.
* WordPress personal data exporter and eraser for the withdrawal statements, and suggested privacy policy text.

easy-withdrawal.desc_el: Φόρμα υπαναχώρησης για πελάτες και επισκέπτες, με απόδειξη και λίστα αιτημάτων.
easy-withdrawal.desc_en: Withdrawal form for customers and guests, with a receipt and a request list.
easy-withdrawal.name: Easy Withdrawal

beta.changelog: * Personal data: WordPress's exporter and eraser (Tools → Export / Erase Personal Data). The export lists the stamped copies kept for the address; the eraser deletes them (a later download makes a new one).

ebook-delivery.desc_el: Υδατογράφημα με τα στοιχεία του αγοραστή στα PDF και EPUB που πουλάς, σελίδα «Η βιβλιοθήκη μου» στον λογαριασμό του πελάτη και εργαλείο που βρίσκει από ποια παραγγελία βγήκε ένα αρχείο που διέρρευσε.
ebook-delivery.desc_en: Buyer watermarks in the PDF and EPUB files you sell, a «My library» page in the customer's account and a tool that finds which order a leaked file came from.
ebook-delivery.name: Ebook Delivery

beta.changelog: * Suggested privacy policy text for tickets and attendee names (Settings → Privacy → Policy guide).

events.desc_el: Εκδηλώσεις (παρουσιάσεις, βραδιές, υπογραφές, συναυλίες, εργαστήρια, online) με ημερομηνία, χώρο, κατάσταση και είσοδο, συνδεδεμένες με προϊόντα και δημιουργούς: λίστα επερχόμενων, αρχείο, «Πρόσθεσε στο ημερολόγιο» και Event schema.
events.desc_en: Events (book presentations, evenings, signings, concerts, workshops, online) with a date, venue, status and entry, linked to products and creators: an upcoming list, an archive, «Add to calendar» and Event schema.
events.name: Events

fast-pages.desc_el: Page cache για επισκέπτες με έξυπνο καθάρισμα και preload, minify CSS / JS, lazy load και YouTube με κλικ. Αντικαθιστά το WP Rocket· ο Claude το χειρίζεται μέσω Site Bridge.
fast-pages.desc_en: A page cache for visitors with smart purging and preload, CSS / JS minify, lazy load and click-to-play YouTube. Replaces WP Rocket; Claude runs it through Site Bridge.
fast-pages.name: Fast Pages

beta.changelog: * Support links (the footer pill and the Donate link) point to noxpress.tech/support/ instead of Ko-fi, with the label «♡ Support Noxpress». Noxpress Core 1.6.0: the same link in the hub, and Visitor Language in the suite catalogue.

featured-creators.desc_el: Μία σελίδα για κάθε δημιουργό, με τα έργα του ανά ρόλο, συνδέσμους από τα προϊόντα και ευρετήριο.
featured-creators.desc_en: One page for every creator, with their works by role, links from the products and an index.
featured-creators.name: Featured Creators

beta.changelog: * Support links (the footer pill and the Donate link) point to noxpress.tech/support/ instead of Ko-fi, with the label «♡ Support Noxpress». Noxpress Core 1.6.0: the same link in the hub, and Visitor Language in the suite catalogue.

forms.desc_el: Φόρμες επικοινωνίας με block και shortcode, ειδοποίηση με email και προστασία από spam χωρίς υπηρεσίες τρίτων. Κανένα μήνυμα δεν χάνεται όταν αποτύχει το email, και εισαγωγή από το Contact Form 7 με το ίδιο shortcode.
forms.desc_en: Contact forms with a block and a shortcode, e-mail notifications and spam protection without third-party services. No message is lost when the e-mail fails, and an import from Contact Form 7 that keeps its shortcode.
forms.name: Forms

beta.changelog: * Privacy: retention setting for the names and message of finished cards (365 days by default, 0 = never), clean-up of gift card order lines and their finished cards when WooCommerce removes an order's personal data, and suggested privacy policy text (Settings → Privacy → Policy guide).

gift-cards.desc_el: Ψηφιακές δωροκάρτες ως προϊόν, με αποστολή σε ημερομηνία με email και εκτυπώσιμο PDF, εξαργύρωση ως πληρωμή στο κλασικό και στο block ταμείο, υπόλοιπο για την επόμενη αγορά και ημερολόγιο κάθε κίνησης.
gift-cards.desc_en: Digital gift cards as a product, delivered on a date by email with a printable PDF, redeemed as a payment in the classic and block checkout, with the balance kept for the next order and a ledger of every movement.
gift-cards.name: Gift Cards

beta.changelog: * Support links (the footer pill and the Donate link) point to noxpress.tech/support/ instead of Ko-fi, with the label «♡ Support Noxpress». Noxpress Core 1.6.0: the same link in the hub, and Visitor Language in the suite catalogue.

greeklish-permalinks.desc_el: Ελληνικά σε λατινικά στα slugs και στα ονόματα αρχείων, με μαζική μετατροπή των υπαρχόντων.
greeklish-permalinks.desc_en: Greek to Latin in slugs and file names, with bulk conversion of existing ones.
greeklish-permalinks.name: Greeklish Permalinks

beta.changelog: * Support links (the footer pill and the Donate link) point to noxpress.tech/support/ instead of Ko-fi, with the label «♡ Support Noxpress». Noxpress Core 1.6.0: the same link in the hub, and Visitor Language in the suite catalogue.

hide-catalog.desc_el: Απόκρυψη κατηγοριών και των προϊόντων τους από το shop, την αναζήτηση και τα blocks, χωρίς αλλαγή στα προϊόντα.
hide-catalog.desc_en: Hide categories and their products from the shop, search and blocks, without changing the products.
hide-catalog.name: Hide Catalog

beta.changelog: * Support links (the footer pill and the Donate link) point to noxpress.tech/support/ instead of Ko-fi, with the label «♡ Support Noxpress». Noxpress Core 1.6.0: the same link in the hub, and Visitor Language in the suite catalogue.

home-sections.desc_el: Ενότητες προϊόντων με το shortcode [products]: marker classes που εξαιρούν προϊόντα, κατηγορίες ή προπαραγγελίες και φιλτράρουν με λέξη στον τίτλο.
home-sections.desc_en: Product sections with the [products] shortcode: marker classes that leave out products, categories or pre-orders and filter by a word in the title.
home-sections.name: Home Sections

beta.changelog: * Support links (the footer pill and the Donate link) point to noxpress.tech/support/ instead of Ko-fi, with the label «♡ Support Noxpress». Noxpress Core 1.6.0: the same link in the hub, and Visitor Language in the suite catalogue.

invoice-details.desc_el: Απόδειξη ή τιμολόγιο στο ταμείο (κλασικό και block): επωνυμία, ΑΦΜ, ΔΟΥ και δραστηριότητα, έλεγχος του ελληνικού ΑΦΜ με το ψηφίο ελέγχου και των ΑΦΜ της ΕΕ στο VIES, τα στοιχεία στην παραγγελία και στα emails, και λίστα τιμολογίων με CSV για τον λογιστή.
invoice-details.desc_en: Receipt or invoice at checkout (classic and block): company name, VAT number, tax office and activity, a check-digit test for Greek numbers and a VIES check for EU ones, the details on the order and in the emails, and an invoice list with CSV for the accountant.
invoice-details.name: Invoice Details

beta.changelog: * Support links (the footer pill and the Donate link) point to noxpress.tech/support/ instead of Ko-fi, with the label «♡ Support Noxpress». Noxpress Core 1.6.0: the same link in the hub, and Visitor Language in the suite catalogue.

lean-images.desc_el: Οι εικόνες JPEG και PNG γίνονται WebP (και προαιρετικά AVIF) στον δικό σου server, σε μικρές παρτίδες στο παρασκήνιο. Τα πρωτότυπα δεν αλλάζουν ποτέ, χωρίς λογαριασμό, όριο ή εξωτερική υπηρεσία.
lean-images.desc_en: JPEG and PNG images become WebP (and optionally AVIF) on your own server, in small background batches. The originals never change; no account, quota or external service.
lean-images.name: Lean Images

beta.changelog: * Privacy (Bible §12 «Προσωπικά δεδομένα»): suggested privacy policy text (Settings → Privacy): the operator's push notifications, the end-to-end encrypted message preview, and that the chat itself is the chat plugin's.

live-operator.desc_el: Το live chat του PurioChat στο κινητό: διακόπτης online / offline, ειδοποιήσεις για κάθε αίτημα και μήνυμα, και απαντήσεις από την εφαρμογή Android.
live-operator.desc_en: The live chat of PurioChat Pro on your phone: an online / offline switch kept on the server, a notification for every request and message, and replies from an app.
live-operator.name: Live Operator

stable.changelog: * Other apps of this site: assetlinks.json can also declare up to 5 other Android apps of the same site (a shop's own app), each as its own statement, so they open the site's links as App Links. Settings › Android app, one «package fingerprint» pair per line.

beta.changelog: * Support links (the footer pill and the Donate link) point to noxpress.tech/support/ instead of Ko-fi, with the label «♡ Support Noxpress». Noxpress Core 1.6.0: the same link in the hub, and Visitor Language in the suite catalogue.

live-search.desc_el: Αναζήτηση προϊόντων με προτάσεις καθώς γράφει ο επισκέπτης: τίτλος, ISBN, συγγραφείς, χωρίς τόνους, με greeklish και με ανοχή σε μικρά λάθη. Οι φόρμες του θέματος μένουν ίδιες, ένα ακριβές ISBN ανοίγει κατευθείαν το προϊόν, και εισαγωγή από το FiboSearch.
live-search.desc_en: Product search with suggestions as the visitor types: title, ISBN, authors, without accents, with greeklish and tolerant of small typos. The theme's forms stay the same, an exact ISBN opens the product directly, and an import from FiboSearch.
live-search.name: Live Search

beta.changelog: * Personal data: WordPress's exporter and eraser (Tools → Export / Erase Personal Data). The export lists the account's log rows, known devices and whether two-step verification is on; the eraser deletes the log rows and known devices and keeps two-step verification with a message.

login-guard.desc_el: Όριο αποτυχημένων συνδέσεων ανά IP και ανά λογαριασμό με κλείδωμα και ξεκλείδωμα με email, κλείσιμο των συνδέσεων μέσω XML-RPC, προστασία από απαρίθμηση χρηστών και email σε σύνδεση διαχειριστή από νέα συσκευή.
login-guard.desc_en: Limits on failed logins per IP and per account, with lockouts and an unlock link by e-mail, XML-RPC logins switched off, protection against user enumeration and an e-mail when an administrator logs in from a new device.
login-guard.name: Login Guard

beta.changelog: * Personal data: WordPress's exporter and eraser (Tools → Export / Erase Personal Data). The export lists the account's log events and a pending link; the eraser deletes them.

magic-login.desc_el: Σύνδεση πελατών χωρίς κωδικό: σύνδεσμος μίας χρήσης με email από τη φόρμα σύνδεσης και το ταμείο, με λήξη, όριο αιτημάτων και σελίδα επιβεβαίωσης.
magic-login.desc_en: Passwordless login for customers: a one-time link by email from the login form and the checkout, with expiry, rate limits and a confirmation page.
magic-login.name: Magic Login

beta.changelog: * Suggested privacy policy text for the sent log and the optional email content (Settings → Privacy → Policy guide).

mail-relay.desc_el: Όλα τα email του site μέσω SMTP (με έτοιμη ρύθμιση για Proton Mail) ή μέσω Brevo, Mailgun, SendGrid, Postmark και Amazon SES, με εφεδρική σύνδεση, αρχείο αποστολών, δοκιμαστικό email και πάγωμα της αποστολής σε αντίγραφα του site.
mail-relay.desc_en: Every email of the site over SMTP (with a ready setup for Proton Mail) or through Brevo, Mailgun, SendGrid, Postmark and Amazon SES, with a backup connection, a sent log, a test email and sending paused on copies of the site.
mail-relay.name: Mail Relay

beta.changelog: * Privacy (Bible §12 «Προσωπικά δεδομένα»): suggested privacy policy text (Settings → Privacy): the necessary preview cookie and the IP allow list check (nothing stored).

maintenance-mode.desc_el: Σελίδα «Σύντομα κοντά σας» ή «Συντήρηση» για τους επισκέπτες, ενώ εσύ, ο πελάτης με σύνδεσμο προεπισκόπησης και οι IP σου βλέπετε κανονικά το site. 503 με Retry-After ή noindex, ώρα έναρξης και λήξης, καθάρισμα της page cache, και πληρωμές, REST και login που δεν κόβονται ποτέ.
maintenance-mode.desc_en: A «Coming soon» or «Maintenance» page for visitors, while you, your client with a preview link and your IPs see the real site. 503 with Retry-After or noindex, start and end times, page cache purging, and payments, REST and login never cut off.
maintenance-mode.name: Maintenance Mode

beta.changelog: * Privacy: personal data exporter and eraser for the newsletter consent kept with orders (kept as proof of consent unless WooCommerce removes order personal data; the eraser reminds you to remove the address from the orOS Newsletter list).

oros-connect.desc_el: Σύνδεση με το orOS σε modules: φόρμα εγγραφής και κουτάκι στο ταμείο για τη λίστα σου στο orOS Newsletter.
oros-connect.desc_en: Connects the site to orOS in modules: sign-up form and checkout checkbox for your list in orOS Newsletter.
oros-connect.name: orOS Connect

beta.changelog: * Support links (the footer pill and the Donate link) point to noxpress.tech/support/ instead of Ko-fi, with the label «♡ Support Noxpress». Noxpress Core 1.6.0: the same link in the hub, and Visitor Language in the suite catalogue.

pre-orders.desc_el: Προπαραγγελίες με ημερομηνία κυκλοφορίας: σήμα και κουμπί στο κατάστημα, η ημερομηνία στο καλάθι και στην παραγγελία, αυτόματη κυκλοφορία και emails.
pre-orders.desc_en: Pre-orders with a release date: badge and button in the store, the date in the cart and on the order, automatic release and emails.
pre-orders.name: Pre-Orders

beta.changelog: * New setting «Ένδειξη έκπτωσης» (Settings → Bundle page, on by default). Off: a bundle shows only its own price everywhere (product page, shop lists, cart), with no struck-through value and no theme "Sale" badge, is_on_sale() is false and _regular_price = _price, for fixed book price laws (Greek law 4549/2018). The bundle price and the «Χωριστά … · Εξοικονομείς …» line stay as they are. Changing it rebuilds every bundle.

product-bundles.desc_el: Πακέτα προϊόντων: κάθε προϊόν με το δικό του απόθεμα και ΦΠΑ, έκπτωση πακέτου και σωστές αναφορές πωλήσεων.
product-bundles.desc_en: Product bundles: every product with its own stock and VAT, a bundle discount and correct sales reports.
product-bundles.name: Product Bundles

beta.changelog: * Support links (the footer pill and the Donate link) point to noxpress.tech/support/ instead of Ko-fi, with the label «♡ Support Noxpress». Noxpress Core 1.6.0: the same link in the hub, and Visitor Language in the suite catalogue.

product-feed.desc_el: Feeds προϊόντων για Google Merchant Center, Skroutz, BestPrice, τον κατάλογο Meta και CSV: ένα στατικό αρχείο ανά feed με σταθερό URL, ανανέωση στο παρασκήνιο, GTIN / ISBN, εκδότης, προπαραγγελίες, έλεγχος πριν τη δημοσίευση και εισαγωγή από το CTX Feed.
product-feed.desc_en: Product feeds for Google Merchant Center, Skroutz, BestPrice, the Meta catalog and CSV: one static file per feed with a fixed URL, background refresh, GTIN / ISBN, publisher, pre-orders, a check before publishing and an import from CTX Feed.
product-feed.name: Product Feed

beta.changelog: * Support links (the footer pill and the Donate link) point to noxpress.tech/support/ instead of Ko-fi, with the label «♡ Support Noxpress». Noxpress Core 1.6.0: the same link in the hub, and Visitor Language in the suite catalogue.

product-formats.desc_el: Συνδέει τις μορφές ενός έργου (έντυπο, ebook, ηχητικό βιβλίο, ταινία) με το μπλοκ «Διαθέσιμες μορφές».
product-formats.desc_en: Links the formats of a work (print, e-book, audiobook, film) with an "Available formats" block.
product-formats.name: Product Formats

beta.changelog: * Support links (the footer pill and the Donate link) point to noxpress.tech/support/ instead of Ko-fi, with the label «♡ Support Noxpress». Noxpress Core 1.6.0: the same link in the hub, and Visitor Language in the suite catalogue.

product-tabs.desc_el: Επιπλέον καρτέλες στη σελίδα προϊόντος, ανά προϊόν και κοινές ανά κατηγορία, ετικέτα ή είδος, βίντεο που φορτώνουν μόνο με κλικ, μία σειρά για όλες τις καρτέλες και εισαγωγή από το Custom Product Tabs for WooCommerce.
product-tabs.desc_en: Extra tabs on the product page, per product and shared by category, tag or product type, videos that load only on a click, one order for every tab, and an import from Custom Product Tabs for WooCommerce.
product-tabs.name: Product Tabs

beta.changelog: * Support links (the footer pill and the Donate link) point to noxpress.tech/support/ instead of Ko-fi, with the label «♡ Support Noxpress». Noxpress Core 1.6.0: the same link in the hub, and Visitor Language in the suite catalogue.

stable.changelog:
* New: the production flow in the Author Portal can use the publisher's own steps. In the orOS Kanban the publisher marks which columns of a board are steps for the creator, with a name and an explanation (Greek, optional English); orOS sends them with the works (POST rs/v1/production with v 2: flows with their steps in the order of the columns, and each work's flow, step and shop products). The portal shows the steps in order with the current one marked, each step's explanation on hover, keyboard focus or tap (in the portal's language; English falls back to Greek), the date each step was reached, and a link to the work's published shop products. A step or flow that is not in the list skips the work with a reason (bad_flow, bad_step).
* The v1 format (seven fixed phases) still works; the last push is the list. Noxpress → RS Production lists the steps orOS sent.
* Author Portal, at a glance before everything else: the creator's works still in production, as a horizontal bar with stops (a vertical list on phones), then a small table with copies sold (all time, not free copies), the current stock of their titles and the balance to receive. The analyses follow as before. A work at its last step (released) is no longer shown in production.

beta.changelog:
* New module «Κανόνες αποστολής» (Shipping rules, tab of its own, off by default, test mode for shop managers). Made-to-order (partner) products, from chosen shipping classes and the Printful parcel, always pay one flat fee per order whatever the quantity, with a higher fee when the cart holds a large product (classes of their own). The fee replaces the partner's live rates on the partner's package and keeps the cheapest partner rate's id, so the partner's order import reads the order as before; tax included in the fee or none. When the cart is not split (partner API outage), the fee is added to every rate.
* Free shipping counts only products that need shipping, are not the partner's and, when categories are chosen, belong to them (sub-categories included). Carriers' own «free over X» (BOX NOW Delivery) get their cost back when the counted amount is below X; WooCommerce Free shipping with a minimum amount is removed by the same rule. The free-shipping bar and product-page line use the same amount; the bar hides for carts of made-to-order products only, and the product page of a product that does not count shows a line of its own ({fee} for made-to-order products).
* The rules also run in the Store API (Cart and Checkout blocks, place order), since they decide what an order costs. Saving the settings bumps WooCommerce's shipping cache version. Filters shn_rules_partner_product, shn_rules_counts, shn_rules_fee.

stable.changelog:
* New: automatic schedule of the write window, per site (Access → Window schedule, off by default). Up to 3 ranges a day in the site's time zone, a range may run past midnight, up to 30 closed dates. Ranges that touch count as one stretch, and no stretch may be longer than 12 hours (the longest manual window); a DST night is cut at 12 hours too. Worked out on every check, so it is right without cron; one WP-Cron event at the next change only writes the log and sends the e-mail.
* New: "Close now" inside a scheduled stretch (WP admin, Hub, app or Claude's write_window_close) pauses the schedule until that stretch ends; the next one opens as planned. Opening by hand inside a stretch keeps the later end.
* New: an e-mail to the admin address for every change of the write window: opened or closed by hand (and by whom: WP admin, Hub, app or Claude), opened or closed by the schedule, paused, and every schedule edit (before and after). Setting in Access, on by default.
* The site's status gives the Hub and the app what keeps the window open (manual / schedule), the next scheduled opening and the end of a pause; the Hub's Sites tab and list_sites show them. The Site Bridge app 1.8.0 notifies about every change.
* The schedule lives in option sbr_schedule, which no Site Bridge tool can write. Uninstall removes it and its cron event.
